purpose: Commissioning checklist covering pre-commissioning through mechanical completion, energisation, loop checks, flushing, leak testing, start-up, performance test, and handover.

activities.activity: Commissioning team mobilisation and systems familiarisation
activities.safety_hold_point: All team members must have site-specific HSE induction before mobilisation
activities.acceptance_criteria: Full commissioning team on site, kick-off meeting minutes issued, roles and responsibilities clear

activities.activity: Pre-commissioning procedure review and system boundary definition
activities.safety_hold_point: System boundaries reviewed and agreed with construction and operations
activities.acceptance_criteria: Complete system demarcation schedule approved, each system tagged with P&ID reference

activities.activity: Mechanical Completion (MC) dossier compilation per system
prerequisites: All ITP hold points signed off
activities.safety_hold_point: Construction supervisor must confirm system is physically complete and safe for pre-comm
activities.acceptance_criteria: MC dossier includes: design docs, as-builts, MTCs, NDT reports, hydrotest records, NCR close-out, weld maps

activities.activity: MC dossier review and approval by commissioning team
activities.safety_hold_point: Any open NCRs must be risk-assessed and approved by commissioning manager
activities.acceptance_criteria: MC certificate signed by construction, quality, and commissioning — system formally released for pre-comm

activities.activity: Pre-commissioning: piping system cleaning and flushing (water flush / chemical clean)
prerequisites: Temporary strainers installed at equipment inlets
activities.safety_hold_point: Chemical cleaning requires PTW and confined space assessment
activities.acceptance_criteria: Flush water clarity, mesh strainer inspection clean, chemical passivation validated per procedure

activities.activity: Pre-commissioning: pipeline and loop chemical cleaning (if required for critical services)
prerequisites: Chemical cleaning solution and circulation system ready
activities.safety_hold_point: Chemical handling PPE, MSDS review, PTW for hazardous substance use
activities.acceptance_criteria: Sample analysis confirms residual contamination within spec (e.g. Fe < 100 ppm, oil/grease < 20 ppm)

activities.activity: Pre-commissioning: hot oil / thermal fluid circulation (if applicable)
prerequisites: Thermal fluid filled, expansion tank level confirmed
activities.procedure_required: Hot oil circulation and dehydration procedure (HO-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Heating rate per procedure, thermal fluid high-temperature alarms tested
activities.acceptance_criteria: Thermal fluid dehydrated to manufacturer spec (< 200 ppm water), circulation temperature profile stable

activities.activity: Pre-commissioning: drying and inerting (nitrogen sweep) of process systems
prerequisites: Temporary connections for nitrogen supply ready
activities.safety_hold_point: Nitrogen atmosphere — confined space entry prohibited until O2 verified > 19.5%
activities.acceptance_criteria: Oxygen content below 2% in system (for fuel gas/hydrocarbon service), dew point within spec

activities.activity: Hydrostatic leak test of piping systems (per hydrotest package)
activities.procedure_required: Hydrostatic test procedure per ASME B31.3
activities.safety_hold_point: Pneumatic test must have separate risk assessment — hydrostatic is preferred
activities.acceptance_criteria: Holds test pressure for minimum hold time per code, no visible leaks, no pressure drop beyond accepted tolerance

activities.activity: Pneumatic leak test (if hydrostatic not feasible)
prerequisites: Hydrostatic not possible (dry gas service, lined pipe, etc)
activities.safety_hold_point: All personnel excluded from test area, remote pressurisation, continuous monitoring
activities.acceptance_criteria: Holds test pressure per procedure, soap bubble test shows no leaks

activities.activity: Leak tightness test (LT) of flanges and joints after bolt-up
prerequisites: Hydrotest complete, flanges re-torqued per joint integrity procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Pressure staged in increments, no live-loading of bolts at full test pressure
activities.acceptance_criteria: Zero visible leakage at all flanges, gaskets, threaded connections, instrument take-offs

activities.activity: Electrical pre-commissioning: meggar testing of all cables and motors
activities.safety_hold_point: LOTO applied to all sources, discharged after test, PTW for high-voltage testing
activities.acceptance_criteria: IR values per cable type and voltage class: HV > 1000 MΩ, LV > 10 MΩ minimum

activities.activity: Electrical pre-commissioning: HV/LV switchgear primary injection testing
activities.safety_hold_point: High-energy test — exclusion zone, only authorised test personnel
activities.acceptance_criteria: CT ratio, polarity, and saturation verified per protection scheme, relay operates at calculated values

activities.activity: Electrical pre-commissioning: secondary injection (relay calibration) testing
activities.procedure_required: Secondary injection test procedure per protection coordinator scheme (SI-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Relay trip outputs verified; ensure no unintended equipment start
activities.acceptance_criteria: All protection relays operate at 90-110% of set point, time curves match coordination study within 5%

activities.activity: Electrical energisation: HV switchgear incomer and bus-section
activities.safety_hold_point: PTW and energisation permit from utility. Only authorised personnel in switchroom. Emergency stop tested.
activities.acceptance_criteria: HV incomer energised, bus voltage stable within ±5%, bus-section auto-changeover tested, voltage presence confirmed on all outgoing breakers

activities.activity: Electrical energisation: LV switchgear, MCC, and UPS
activities.safety_hold_point: LOTO on all downstream motor starters until run-in
activities.acceptance_criteria: All MCCs energised, voltage present at each starter, UPS in bypass then inverter mode, battery charger float voltage within spec

activities.activity: Instrumentation: loop continuity and IO mapping check
activities.safety_hold_point: SIS loops must have separate calibration check before normal loop test
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% of loops checked: signal source at field → DCS input value matches within spec, output command from DCS → field actuator responds correctly

activities.activity: Instrumentation: impulse line and tubing pressure test
prerequisites: All instrument tubing run and connected
activities.safety_hold_point: Maximum test pressure not to exceed component rating
activities.acceptance_criteria: No leakage at all compression fittings and connections at 1.5x maximum service pressure

activities.activity: Instrumentation: DCS/SIS/PLC software load and configuration check
activities.procedure_required: DCS software load procedure / SAT procedure per vendor
activities.safety_hold_point: SIS configuration must be validated against safety requirements specification (SRS)
activities.acceptance_criteria: Software load without errors, all IO mapped to correct tags, graphics functional, alarm list aligns with alarm philosophy

activities.activity: Equipment run-in: pump run test (water batching)
activities.safety_hold_point: Coupling guard installed, suction valve open, minimum flow recirculation line open
activities.acceptance_criteria: Run 1 hour at rated speed: bearing temperature stable < 75°C, vibration within ISO 10816 limits, no abnormal noise, seal leak within spec

activities.activity: Equipment run-in: compressor run-in (oil circulation, seal gas, start sequence)
prerequisites: Lube oil system flushed and filled
activities.safety_hold_point: Surge line open to atmosphere during initial run, relief valves verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: Mechanical run 4 hours at rated speed: bearing/seal temperatures stable, vibration within API limits, lube oil pressure and temperature correct
activities.responsible_role: Rotating Equipment Engineer / OEM Service Rep

activities.activity: Equipment run-in: motor no-load run and direction check
activities.safety_hold_point: PTW for high voltage test, LOTO on source before termination adjustment
activities.acceptance_criteria: Motor runs to rated speed in correct direction (phase rotation verified), current draw at no-load within specification

activities.activity: Utilities commission: instrument air system
activities.safety_hold_point: Pressure in steps, moisture trap draining in procedure
activities.acceptance_criteria: Dew point < -40°C, pressure maintained at minimum header pressure, oil carry-over < 0.1 ppm, backup compressor auto-start tested

activities.activity: Utilities commission: cooling water system
prerequisites: Cooling towers / cooling water pumps run-in
activities.safety_hold_point: Chemical dosing (biocides/corrosion inhibitor) — COSHH assessment required
activities.acceptance_criteria: Flow and pressure at each user point per spec, return temperature rise within design, water quality within chemical treatment limits

activities.activity: Utilities commission: nitrogen / inert gas system
activities.safety_hold_point: Nitrogen — asphyxiation risk, O2 monitoring in enclosed spaces
activities.acceptance_criteria: Nitrogen purity > 99.9% (or specified), distribution pressure maintained at header setting, no leaks on distribution system

activities.activity: Utilities commission: steam system (if applicable)
activities.safety_hold_point: Warm-up rate per procedure to avoid thermal shock, all traps open during warm-up
activities.acceptance_criteria: Steam quality (dryness fraction) per spec, steam blowing completed to target (erosion target clean), supply pressure and temperature stable

activities.activity: Catalyst loading (if applicable — reactor or adsorber beds)
activities.safety_hold_point: Confined space entry during loading — continuous O2 and LEL monitoring. Loading density checked per bed height.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Catalyst loaded to target density (±2% variation), settling tap applied, bed height recorded, closure inspection passed

activities.activity: Refractory dry-out (fired heaters, reformers, furnaces, incinerators)
activities.safety_hold_point: Ramp rate strictly per curve — thermal shock will destroy refractory
activities.acceptance_criteria: Temperature profile matches dry-out curve, moisture content in refractory < 1%, no spalling or cracking observed

activities.activity: Ready for Start-Up (RFSU) review and sign-off
activities.safety_hold_point: All safety systems verified functional: fire and gas detection, ESD, depressurisation, blowdown
activities.acceptance_criteria: RFSU certificate signed by commissioning manager, operations manager, and HSE manager. Plant declared ready for first feed.

activities.activity: Start-up: safety system functional verification (ESD, F&G, depressurisation)
activities.safety_hold_point: Failure of any safety system during test = NO-GO for start-up
activities.acceptance_criteria: All ESD pushbuttons initiate correct shutdown level, F&G detection actuates alarms and tripping per logic, blowdown valves open within spec time

activities.activity: Start-up: first feed introduction and initial process stabilisation
activities.procedure_required: Start-up sequence procedure per operations manual (SU-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: First feed ramp rate per procedure — immediate hold if any abnormal parameter
activities.acceptance_criteria: Process stabilised at steady-state conditions: temperature, pressure, level, flow within operating window for 4 hours continuous

activities.activity: Start-up: ramp-up to nameplate capacity (staged approach)
prerequisites: Product to intermediate storage route confirmed
activities.safety_hold_point: Ramp rate not to exceed +10% of rate per hour unless procedure permits faster
activities.acceptance_criteria: Plant operating at 100% nameplate capacity with all key parameters within design range, product quality within spec

activities.activity: Performance guarantee test: throughput and capacity
prerequisites: Plant at steady state at nameplate capacity
All utilities and feed streams verified at guarantee conditions
activities.procedure_required: Performance test protocol per EPC contract (PT-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Performance test duration agreed: typically 72 consecutive hours at > 95% capacity
activities.acceptance_criteria: Average throughput over test period >= 100% of guaranteed capacity, sustained without extraordinary intervention

activities.activity: Performance guarantee test: product quality and yield
prerequisites: Laboratory at readiness for all quality parameters
activities.procedure_required: Product quality test protocol per contract (PQ-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Sample frequency per protocol — if quality drifts outside spec, test clock resets
activities.acceptance_criteria: All product quality parameters within contractual limits across test duration, yield meets or exceeds guarantee value

activities.activity: Performance guarantee test: utility consumption and emissions
activities.procedure_required: Utility / emissions measurement protocol per contract (UE-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Emission breaches during test = test failure — regulatory notification required if beyond consented limits
activities.acceptance_criteria: Normalised utility consumption within guarantee envelope, all emissions below statutory limit and guarantee value

activities.activity: Provisional Acceptance Certificate (PAC) issuance
prerequisites: Final test report issued and agreed
Outstanding minor items listed in log
activities.procedure_required: PAC certificate template per EPC contract
activities.safety_hold_point: All safety-critical guarantees must be met before PAC can be signed
activities.acceptance_criteria: PAC signed by owner and EPC contractor, effective date established, retention percentage agreed per contract

activities.activity: Operator training completion and competency verification
activities.procedure_required: Operator training record and competency assessment checklist
activities.safety_hold_point: Each operator must pass written and practical competency assessment before independent duty
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% of operations and maintenance staff trained, competency assessment passed, refresher schedule agreed

activities.activity: As-built documentation handover and project close-out
prerequisites: All as-built drawings collected from site and vendor
activities.procedure_required: Document handover checklist per contract / project close-out procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Statutory documents (pressure vessel certs, boiler certs) must be physically handed over
activities.acceptance_criteria: As-built document set complete per contract deliverable list, operating manuals transferred, spare parts and special tools handed over, warranty period start date agreed
